summary: Unquoted values such as value=trust produce misleading expectations for true, false, inf, or nan. The fix dispatches those literals by initial byte and labels failures as expecting a quoted string. The implementation reversal is exact and unique. Blocked test selection: detecting coverage exists in tests/test_invalid.rs through the fs_snapshot case string-no-quotes-constant-like.toml, whose expected diagnostic this commit updates. This harness=false target generates fixture-based cases rather than named Rust test functions; prototype/mine.py requires a matching fn declaration and cannot select this case. No suitable named Rust regression test was found. No builds or tests were run.
